subject: SIG: Secure SDLC artifact manifest & custody log
messages:
From: Patrick Ng <patrick.ng@brightbridge.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: SIG request: SDLC artifact manifest and custody log

Hi Jonas,

We're kicking off the SIG review for FinServCo and need a consolidated artifact manifest for your Secure SDLC controls. To complete the evidence matrix the assessor team needs:

- Code review policy and a representative sample of PRs (with review timestamps & approvers).
- CI/CD pipeline configuration and a redacted run log showing gating checks.
- Secrets management proof: rotation events for KMS/keystore, ephemeral token usage, and who has custodial access (last 12 months).
- Change management trail: approval records, canary/full rollouts, and emergency patch justification logs.
- Any key mitigations (e.g., automated secret scanning, protected branches, PR size limits).

Please provide a manifest that maps each artifact to a filepath/Drive link and the custody owner. We prefer a single spreadsheet and supporting artifacts (pdf/logs/tar.gz).

Target turnaround: 3 business days if possible. If any items require a narrower scope or you need more time, reply with a plan and ETA.

Assessor portal link for uploads: https://assess.security-assess.com/finservco/requests/HS-12345

Thanks,
Patrick Ng
Senior Assessor, BrightBridge Audit
patrick.ng@brightbridge.com

--
On behalf of FinServCo CISO office, please treat these artifacts as sensitive.
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG request: SDLC artifact manifest and custody log

Team — forwarding the request from BrightBridge for the FinServCo SIG. Action items below:

- Marissa: compile code-review artifacts (policy doc + 3 PRs that show cross-team reviews + reviewer timestamps).
- Karthik: export CI run config and a redacted log from the gating pipeline; include pipeline version and any OPA/guard checks.
- Hannah: produce the change management timeline for the last 12 months (approvals, emergency patches, and rollouts).

Keep everything tagged with the artifact-manifest workbook name (artifact-manifest-v1.xlsx). We should avoid including private keys or full secrets in the uploads — include redacted samples and a rotation ledger instead.

If you hit blockers (legal/3rd-party redaction, missing approvals), escalate to me and I’ll coordinate with Patrick to scope.

Please reply with the manifest + attachments ASAP; aim for EOD Tue (3 business days). I’ve CC'd the security/compliance inbox for visibility.

Thanks,
Jonas
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Jonas / team — progress update.

Attached (see manifest reference):
- code-review-policy-v1.2.pdf (Policy includes branch protection and reviewer SLAs).
- sample-prs-2026-09.tar.gz (three PRs: #3412, #3578, #3661; each contains reviewer stamps and timestamps; personally redacted user tokens).
- artifact-manifest-v1.xlsx (sheet maps each artifact to owner and Drive path).

Notes: our sample PRs include cross-team reviews and autosuggested reviewer assignment screenshots. I flagged one PR that used an emergency bypass (we have an emergency-approval PDF in the manifest).

Next: Karthik — once we have CI logs and the secret rotation ledger, I will finalize the manifest and push to the assessor folder.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Engineering Manager, Developer Experience
Redwood Inference

Attachments: code-review-policy-v1.2.pdf (policy), sample-prs-2026-09.tar.gz (archive), artifact-manifest-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG request: SDLC artifact manifest and custody log

Uploading the CI/secret evidence pieces — see manifest pointers.

Provided artifacts (attached / Drive):
- ci-pipeline-export-20261126.log (redacted run showing unit/integration/gate checks + OPA policy enforcement).
- secret-rotation-summary-202611.csv (rotation events for KMS keys & deploy tokens; column headers: key_id, rotated_at, owner, justification).
- change-approval-timeline-202611.pdf (timeline of approvals for major releases and emergency patch rollouts).

I also included a short readme inside the Drive folder that explains our redaction policy and how to verify the exported logs. Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AaBbCcManifestLink

A few caveats:
- KMS key material never leaves the vault; the ledger shows rotation timestamps and the principal who initiated rotation.
- For ephemeral tokens we provide issuance/expiry metadata rather than tokens themselves.
- We redacted service account IDs where required by contracts — the readme lists which IDs are redacted and why.

If BrightBridge needs full unredacted artifacts for in-person review, liaise via the assessor portal and we'll schedule a supervised session.

Karthik Iyer
Principal SRE
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ci-pipeline-export-20261126.log (text log), secret-rotation-summary-202611.csv (csv), change-approval-timeline-202611.pdf (pdf)
